summary: GigCapital8 Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated October 8, 2026, with Quantisimo Holdings Corp. (PubCo), Quantisimo Corp., and company shareholders WISeQey Corp and SealSQ Corp. The two-step deal merges SPAC Merger Sub into GigCapital8, then Target Merger Sub into Quantisimo, leaving both as PubCo subsidiaries. No price per share, premium, or close date stated. The 8-K also covers unregistered equity sales and exhibits; a prior October 9 8-K referenced the same agreement. Watch for investor-approval and redemption mechanics.
